verdicts.reason: A keeps the logo legible, centred above the headline. But the flavour list is small, its dots step out of line row by row, and the order is reshuffled (Lime Zap moved last). The CTA is a tiny button with illegible text, cut off from everything at the bottom-left, which leaves a large dead area on the left. B makes the headline and list larger and easier to read. But it shrinks the FIZZBANG! logo to an illegible chip in the top-left corner, which hurts the brand, and moves the tiny CTA to the top-right, where it is read before the headline. The list in B is also ragged (Lime Zap's dot is offset) and reordered, and the lower-left is empty.
